title: Grateful Dead Live at Grand Prix Racecourse on 1973-07-27
lineage: AudMC stereo> ? > C > DAT > WAV > SHN, unknown taper

ai_review.summary: Full, crowd‑rich audience recording of a rare soundcheck that showcases an almost celestial Jam and lively Bird Song.
ai_review.review: This tape captures a laid‑back Watkins Glen soundcheck with surprisingly rich audio – the mix is full, includes crowd reaction, and avoids the harsh cuts found on some older SBD versions. The musical highlight is the extended Jam (especially its final six–seven minutes) which many reviewers describe as heavenly, with Jerry’s guitar soaring like “Starship”, plus a fun rendition of Bird Song.

ai_rating.rationale: All ten reviews are strongly positive (4–5 stars) and praise both the performance and the audio quality; the consistent enthusiasm yields a high confidence rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Full, warm sound with crowd ambience; no harsh cuts in Bird Song, Half Step or Big Jam that plague some SBD copies; clarity improves after the ear adjusts.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A relaxed soundcheck/rehearsal vibe with a soaring Jam leading into Wharf Rat; the band is loose but inspired, making the free‑bie feel like a genuine Dead moment.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers note Jerry’s transcendent guitar work on the Jam ("Starship", celestial vibes) and his lyrical improvisation.
